thread_scope_result.rationale: The corrigendum explicitly targets the amendment of Article 4(1), not Article 3. It is relevant provenance for the 2025 amending act but does not create an Article 3 text state, mutation, Change Atom, or rule-lineage event.

forbidden_inferences: A corrigendum to an act that also amended Article 3 must not automatically be attached as an Article 3 mutation.
A language being listed for the corrigendum does not imply that Article 3 changed in that language.
The 2026 publication date must not create a new Article 3 text-state boundary without provision-scoped evidence.

thread_handling.source_mode_note: Expose on provenance/source inspection to explain why the later corrigendum was considered and excluded from the Article 3 mutation timeline.
